title: tissue — the transplantable pack of one specialization
description: A tissue declares nothing new. Every list below holds ids that already exist in their own source (an agent dir, a SKILL.md, a table definition, a manifest row, a plugin pulse job, an importer, a seed); files/anatomy/module_utils/nos_tissue.py resolves each one and refuses a dangling reference. `meta` is the Tier-2 app manifest's own block (state/schema/app.schema.json), plus a licence. There is no gdpr block on purpose: Article 30 is inherited from the members that process data. Doctrine: docs/doctrine/tissues.md.

license.description: SPDX id. The pack travels as plain files under this licence.

skills.description: files/anatomy/skills/<id>/SKILL.md — the distributed library only; a project skill under .claude/ does not travel

reflexes.description: <owner>:<job> — a pulse.jobs[] row of files/anatomy/plugins/<owner>-base/plugin.yml (the anatomy graph's pulse:<owner>:<job>)

importers.description: state/digest-importers/<id>.importer.yml — the doors data enters by

seeds.description: state/fixtures/<id>.seed.yml — reference knowledge the tissue starts with (no personal data)

profile.description: profiles/<id>.yml — the overlay that installs it

acceptance.description: fixture ids: state/fixtures/<id>.seed.yml + state/fixtures/<id>/expected.yml, and roadmap row fixture-<id>
